dedupe_keys.name: mozfields 2023 satellite based crop field delineations for mozambique

description: MozFields gives national crop field boundaries for Mozambique for 2023. The Zenodo record says they come from a pre-trained FracTAL ResUNet model fine-tuned with pseudo-labels, applied to commercial 1.5 m SPOT 6 and 7 imagery from Airbus through the Descartes Labs platform, with 2021 and 2022 images filling gaps, and that fields exclude fallows, tree crops, agroforestry and rangelands. It was published in April 2026 by researchers at the UCLouvain Earth and Life Institute and co-authors, in a project funded by the F.R.S.-FNRS. The field delineations are available on request for non-commercial research, with no fee stated, while derived cropland fraction and field size maps are openly downloadable. Coverage is Mozambique. Caveats: mixed image years, and tree crops are missing. For simulation it gives field-level smallholder agriculture to model cyclone, flood and drought exposure. Related catalogue records include the Africa crop field boundary labels and the Radiant Earth African crop type reference data.
